+var _act_btn: Button
+var _new_box: Control
+var _name_style_ok: StyleBox
+var _name_style_bad: StyleBoxFlat
+
+
+## A browser over `owner`'s screen (its own layer); the browser node (freed when it closes).
+static func open(owner: Node, opts: Dictionary) -> Control:
+	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
+	layer.layer = 60
+	owner.add_child(layer)
+	var fb: Control = load("res://scripts/ui/file_browser.gd").new()
+	fb.title = str(opts.get("title", "Save As"))
+	fb.action = str(opts.get("action", "Save As"))
+	fb.filters = opts.get("filters", ["glb", "gltf"])
+	fb.thumb = opts.get("thumb", Callable())
+	fb.done = opts.get("done", Callable())
+	fb.cancel = opts.get("cancel", Callable())
+	fb.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	fb.name = "FileBrowser"
+	layer.add_child(fb)
+	fb._build()
+	var d := str(opts.get("dir", "res://"))
+	fb._go(d if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(d) else "res://", false)
+	fb._name_le.text = str(opts.get("file", ""))
+	fb._name_changed(fb._name_le.text)
+	fb._name_le.grab_focus.call_deferred()
+	fb._name_le.select_all.call_deferred()
+	return fb
+
+
+func _build() -> void:
+	var box := UI.modal(self, NeonTheme.HEAD, Vector2(1120, 700))
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_child(UI.label(title, 24, NeonTheme.HEAD))
+	box.add_child(head)
+	# the toolbar
+	var bar := HBoxContainer.new()
+	bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	box.add_child(bar)
+	bar.add_child(_tool("back", "Back", "Alt+Left", "The folder shown before.", _go_back))
+	bar.add_child(_tool("forward", "Forward", "Alt+Right", "The folder gone back from.", _go_fwd))
+	bar.add_child(_tool("up", "Parent folder", "Backspace", "The folder this one is in.", _go_up))
+	bar.add_child(_tool("reload", "Refresh", "", "The folder read again.", func(): _go(dir, false)))
+	bar.add_child(_tool("add", "New folder", "", "A new folder in this one (you name it).", _new_folder))
+	_path_le = LineEdit.new()
+	_path_le.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_path_le.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	_path_le.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Folder", "Enter", "The folder shown - type a path and press Enter to go there.")
+	_path_le.text_submitted.connect(func(t: String):
+		var p := t.strip_edges()
+		if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(p):
+			_go(p)
+		else:
+			_say("No folder %s." % p, true))
+	bar.add_child(_path_le)
+	_search_le = LineEdit.new()
+	_search_le.placeholder_text = "Search"
+	_search_le.custom_minimum_size.x = 190
+	_search_le.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	_search_le.clear_button_enabled = true
+	_search_le.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Search", "", "Only the files and folders whose names have these letters.")
+	_search_le.text_changed.connect(func(_t): _fill())
+	bar.add_child(_search_le)
+	var flt := _tool("mesh", "Only %s files" % ", ".join(filters.map(func(e): return "." + str(e))), "", "Show only the files that can be saved here (on), or every file (off).", Callable())
+	flt.toggle_mode = true
+	flt.button_pressed = true
+	flt.toggled.connect(func(on: bool): _only_filtered = on; _fill())
+	bar.add_child(flt)
+	var tm := _tool("m_icons", "Thumbnails", "", "The files as pictures (on) or as a list with their dates and sizes (off).", Callable())
+	tm.toggle_mode = true
+	tm.toggled.connect(func(on: bool): _thumbs_mode = on; _fill())
+	bar.add_child(tm)
+	# places | files
+	var split := HSplitContainer.new()
+	split.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	split.split_offset = 210
+	box.add_child(split)
+	var side := VBoxContainer.new()
+	side.custom_minimum_size.x = 200
+	side.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	split.add_child(side)
+	side.add_child(UI.section("Places"))
+	_places = ItemList.new()
+	_places.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_places.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	side.add_child(_places)
+	for pl in _place_list():
+		var i := _places.add_item(pl[0], EditorIcons.get_icon("open"))
+		_places.set_item_metadata(i, pl[1])
+		_places.set_item_tooltip(i, pl[1])
+	_places.item_selected.connect(func(i: int): _go(str(_places.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	side.add_child(UI.section("Recent"))
+	_recent = ItemList.new()
+	_recent.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_recent.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	side.add_child(_recent)
+	for d in _recent_dirs():
+		var i := _recent.add_item(_short(d), EditorIcons.get_icon("open"))
+		_recent.set_item_metadata(i, d)
+		_recent.set_item_tooltip(i, d)
+	_recent.item_selected.connect(func(i: int): _go(str(_recent.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	var files := VBoxContainer.new()
+	files.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	split.add_child(files)
+	_tree = Tree.new()
+	_tree.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_tree.columns = 3
+	_tree.column_titles_visible = true
+	_tree.hide_root = true
+	_tree.select_mode = Tree.SELECT_ROW
+	_tree.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	_tree.add_theme_font_size_override("title_button_font_size", 15)
+	_tree.set_column_title(0, "Name")
+	_tree.set_column_title(1, "Date modified")
+	_tree.set_column_title(2, "Size")
+	_tree.set_column_expand(0, true)
+	_tree.set_column_expand(1, false)
+	_tree.set_column_expand(2, false)
+	_tree.set_column_custom_minimum_width(1, 190)
+	_tree.set_column_custom_minimum_width(2, 110)
+	_tree.column_title_clicked.connect(func(col: int, _mb: int):
+		_desc = (not _desc) if col == _sort else false
+		_sort = col
+		_fill())
+	_tree.item_selected.connect(func():
+		var it := _tree.get_selected()
+		if it:
+			_pick(it.get_metadata(0), false))
+	_tree.item_activated.connect(func():
+		var it := _tree.get_selected()
+		if it:
+			_pick(it.get_metadata(0), true))
+	_tree.gui_input.connect(_list_key)
+	files.add_child(_tree)
+	_grid = ItemList.new()
+	_grid.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_grid.max_columns = 0
+	_grid.icon_mode = ItemList.ICON_MODE_TOP
+	_grid.fixed_icon_size = Vector2i(112, 112)
+	_grid.fixed_column_width = 140
+	_grid.same_column_width = true
+	_grid.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	_grid.visible = false
+	_grid.item_selected.connect(func(i: int): _pick(_grid.get_item_metadata(i), false))
+	_grid.item_activated.connect(func(i: int): _pick(_grid.get_item_metadata(i), true))
+	_grid.gui_input.connect(_list_key)
+	files.add_child(_grid)
+	# the new folder's name (shown by New folder)
+	_new_box = HBoxContainer.new()
+	_new_box.visible = false
+	(_new_box as HBoxContainer).add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	files.add_child(_new_box)
+	_new_box.add_child(UI.label("New folder:", 15, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	var nf := LineEdit.new()
+	nf.name = "NewName"
+	nf.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	nf.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
+	nf.text_submitted.connect(func(_t): _make_folder())
+	_new_box.add_child(nf)
+	_new_box.add_child(UI.button("Create", _make_folder, 15))
+	_new_box.add_child(UI.button("Cancel", func(): _new_box.visible = false, 15))
+	# the file's name, and the buttons
+	var foot := HBoxContainer.new()
+	foot.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	box.add_child(foot)
+	_name_le = LineEdit.new()
+	_name_le.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_name_le.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
+	_name_le.placeholder_text = "File name"
+	_name_le.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("File name", "Enter", "The name to save under, in the folder shown (red: a file of that name is there - saving\noverwrites it).")
+	_name_le.text_changed.connect(_name_changed)
+	_name_le.text_submitted.connect(func(_t): _confirm())
+	foot.add_child(_name_le)
+	_name_style_ok = _name_le.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
+	_name_style_bad = StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	_name_style_bad.bg_color = Color(0.45, 0.06, 0.04, 0.9)
+	_name_style_bad.border_color = Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.25)
+	_name_style_bad.set_border_width_all(1)
+	_name_style_bad.set_corner_radius_all(3)
+	_name_style_bad.content_margin_left = 8
+	_name_style_bad.content_margin_right = 8
+	foot.add_child(_tool("remove", "Decrease the number", "Ctrl+Minus", "The number at the end of the name one less.", func(): _bump(-1)))
+	foot.add_child(_tool("add", "Increase the number", "Ctrl+Plus", "The number at the end of the name one more (a 1 added if it has none).", func(): _bump(1)))
+	foot.add_child(UI.button("Cancel", _cancel, 16))
+	_act_btn = UI.button(action, _confirm, 16)
+	_act_btn.name = "Action"
+	foot.add_child(_act_btn)
+	_status = UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	box.add_child(_status)
+
+
+func _tool(icon: String, name: String, keys: String, body: String, fn: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := Button.new()
+	b.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon(icon)
+	b.expand_icon = false
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 34)
+	b.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(name, keys, body)
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	if fn.is_valid():
+		b.pressed.connect(fn)
+	return b
+
+
+## [label, folder] of the places down the side.
+func _place_list() -> Array:
+	var out := [["Game", "res://"]]
+	for d in [["Models", "models"], ["Art", "art"], ["Overrides", "art/overrides"]]:
+		if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute("res://" + d[1]):
+			out.append([d[0], "res://" + d[1]])
+	var home := OS.get_environment("HOME") if OS.get_environment("HOME") != "" else OS.get_environment("USERPROFILE")
+	if home != "":
+		out.append(["Home", home])
+	for k in [OS.SYSTEM_DIR_DESKTOP, OS.SYSTEM_DIR_DOCUMENTS, OS.SYSTEM_DIR_DOWNLOADS]:
+		var p := OS.get_system_dir(k)
+		if p != "" and DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(p):
+			out.append([p.get_file(), p])
+	return out
+
+
+static func _recent_dirs() -> Array:
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(RECENT_FILE):
+		return []
+	var d = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(RECENT_FILE))
+	return (d as Array).filter(func(x): return DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(str(x))) if d is Array else []
+
+
+static func _remember(d: String) -> void:
+	var r := _recent_dirs()
+	r.erase(d)
+	r.push_front(d)
+	r.resize(mini(r.size(), RECENT_MAX))
+	var f := FileAccess.open(RECENT_FILE, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f:
+		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(r))
+
+
+static func _short(d: String) -> String:
+	return d if d.length() < 28 else "..." + d.right(25)
+
+
+## Shows folder `d` (`push`: the one left goes on the Back list).
+func _go(d: String, push := true) -> void:
+	d = _norm(d)
+	if push and d != dir:
+		_back.append(dir)
+		_fwd.clear()
+	dir = d
+	_path_le.text = dir
+	_new_box.visible = false
+	_read()
+	_fill()
+	_name_changed(_name_le.text)
+
+
+func _go_back() -> void:
+	if _back.is_empty():
+		return
+	_fwd.append(dir)
+	_go(_back.pop_back(), false)
+
+
+func _go_fwd() -> void:
+	if _fwd.is_empty():
+		return
+	_back.append(dir)
+	_go(_fwd.pop_back(), false)
+
+
+func _go_up() -> void:
+	if dir == "res://" or dir == "/" or dir.ends_with(":/"):
+		return
+	var up := dir.trim_suffix("/").get_base_dir()
+	if up == "res:":
+		up = "res://"
+	_go(up if up != "" else "/")
+
+
+## A path in one form: res:// inside the game's folder, else absolute; no trailing slash (but a root).
+static func _norm(d: String) -> String:
+	var loc := ProjectSettings.localize_path(d)
+	if loc.begins_with("res://"):
+		d = loc
+	if d.length() > 1 and d.ends_with("/") and d != "res://" and not d.ends_with(":/"):
+		d = d.trim_suffix("/")
+	return d
+
+
+func _read() -> void:
+	_entries = []
+	var da := DirAccess.open(dir)
+	if da == null:
+		_say("Can't read %s." % dir, true)
+		return
+	da.include_hidden = false
+	for d in da.get_directories():
+		if d.begins_with(".") or (dir == "res://" and d == ".godot"):
+			continue
+		_entries.append({"name": d, "dir": true, "time": FileAccess.get_modified_time(dir.path_join(d)), "size": -1})
+	for f in da.get_files():
+		if f.begins_with(".") or f.get_extension() in ["import", "uid"]:
+			continue
+		var full := dir.path_join(f)
+		var fa := FileAccess.open(full, FileAccess.READ)
+		_entries.append({"name": f, "dir": false, "time": FileAccess.get_modified_time(full), "size": fa.get_length() if fa else 0})
+	_say("")
+
+
+## The folder's entries as they're filtered and sorted, into the list or the thumbnails.
+func _fill() -> void:
+	var q := _search_le.text.strip_edges().to_lower()
+	var show := _entries.filter(func(e):
+		if q != "" and not str(e["name"]).to_lower().contains(q):
+			return false
+		return bool(e["dir"]) or not _only_filtered or filters.is_empty() or str(e["name"]).get_extension().to_lower() in filters)
+	var key: String = ["name", "time", "size"][_sort]
+	show.sort_custom(func(a, b):
+		if bool(a["dir"]) != bool(b["dir"]):
+			return bool(a["dir"])
+		var x = str(a["name"]).to_lower() if key == "name" else a[key]
+		var y = str(b["name"]).to_lower() if key == "name" else b[key]
+		if x == y:
+			return str(a["name"]) < str(b["name"])
+		return (x > y) if _desc else (x < y))
+	_tree.visible = not _thumbs_mode
+	_grid.visible = _thumbs_mode
+	for c in 3:
+		_tree.set_column_title(c, ["Name", "Date modified", "Size"][c] + ((" v" if _desc else " ^") if c == _sort else ""))
+	if _thumbs_mode:
+		_grid.clear()
+		for e in show:
+			var full := dir.path_join(str(e["name"]))
+			var tex: Texture2D = null
+			if not bool(e["dir"]) and thumb.is_valid():
+				tex = thumb.call(full)
+			var i := _grid.add_item(str(e["name"]), tex if tex else EditorIcons.get_icon("open" if bool(e["dir"]) else "mesh"))
+			_grid.set_item_metadata(i, e)
+			_grid.set_item_tooltip(i, full)
+		return
+	_tree.clear()
+	var root := _tree.create_item()
+	for e in show:
+		var it := _tree.create_item(root)
+		it.set_text(0, str(e["name"]))
+		it.set_icon(0, EditorIcons.get_icon("open" if bool(e["dir"]) else "mesh"))
+		it.set_icon_max_width(0, 20)
+		it.set_text(1, Time.get_datetime_string_from_unix_time(int(e["time"]), true) if int(e["time"]) > 0 else "")
+		it.set_text(2, "" if bool(e["dir"]) else _size_text(int(e["size"])))
+		it.set_text_alignment(2, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT)
+		it.set_metadata(0, e)
+		it.set_tooltip_text(0, dir.path_join(str(e["name"])))
+		if not bool(e["dir"]) and str(e["name"]) == _with_ext(_name_le.text.strip_edges()):
+			it.select(0)
+
+
+static func _size_text(n: int) -> String:
+	if n < 1024:
+		return "%d B" % n
+	if n < 1024 * 1024:
+		return "%.1f KB" % (n / 1024.0)
+	return "%.1f MB" % (n / 1048576.0)
+
+
+## An entry clicked (`open`: double-clicked): a folder entered (double-click), a file's name taken (and
+## saved under, double-click).
+func _pick(e: Dictionary, open: bool) -> void:
+	if bool(e["dir"]):
+		if open:
+			_go(dir.path_join(str(e["name"])))
+		return
+	_name_le.text = str(e["name"])
+	_name_changed(_name_le.text)
+	if open:
+		_confirm()
+
+
+func _list_key(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventKey and ev.pressed and (ev as InputEventKey).keycode == KEY_BACKSPACE:
+		_go_up()
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+func _input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not (ev is InputEventKey) or not ev.pressed:
+		return
+	var k := ev as InputEventKey
+	if k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
+		_cancel()
+	elif k.alt_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_LEFT:
+		_go_back()
+	elif k.alt_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_RIGHT:
+		_go_fwd()
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode in [KEY_MINUS, KEY_KP_SUBTRACT]:
+		_bump(-1)
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode in [KEY_PLUS, KEY_EQUAL, KEY_KP_ADD]:
+		_bump(1)
+	else:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## The name with the first filter's extension if it has none of them.
+func _with_ext(n: String) -> String:
+	if n == "" or filters.is_empty() or n.get_extension().to_lower() in filters:
+		return n
+	return n + "." + str(filters[0])
+
+
+## The name's number at its end one up or down ("chair" + -> "chair1", "chair_009" + -> "chair_010").
+func _bump(by: int) -> void:
+	var n := _name_le.text.strip_edges()
+	var ext := n.get_extension() if n.get_extension().to_lower() in filters else ""
+	var base := n.get_basename() if ext != "" else n
+	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("^(.*?)(\\d+)$")
+	var m := re.search(base)
+	if m:
+		var digits := m.get_string(2)
+		var v := maxi(0, int(digits) + by)
+		base = m.get_string(1) + str(v).pad_zeros(digits.length())
+	elif by > 0:
+		base += "1"
+	_name_le.text = base + ("." + ext if ext != "" else "")
+	_name_le.caret_column = _name_le.text.length()
+	_name_changed(_name_le.text)
+
+
+func _name_changed(t: String) -> void:
+	var n := _with_ext(t.strip_edges())
+	var there := n != "" and FileAccess.file_exists(dir.path_join(n))
+	_name_le.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _name_style_bad if there else _name_style_ok)
+	_name_le.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _name_style_bad if there else _name_le.get_theme_stylebox("focus", "LineEdit"))
+	_act_btn.disabled = n == "" or n.contains("/") or n.contains("\\")
+	_say("%s is there - %s overwrites it." % [n, action] if there else "")
+
+
+func _confirm() -> void:
+	var n := _with_ext(_name_le.text.strip_edges())
+	if n == "" or n.contains("/") or n.contains("\\"):
+		_say("Give it a name.", true)
+		return
+	if dir.begins_with("res://.godot") or dir.begins_with("res://.git"):
+		_say("Not there: that folder is the engine's.", true)
+		return
+	var full := _norm(dir).path_join(n)
+	_remember(_norm(dir))
+	var fn := done
+	_close()
+	if fn.is_valid():
+		fn.call(full)
+
+
+func _cancel() -> void:
+	var fn := cancel
+	_close()
+	if fn.is_valid():
+		fn.call()
+
+
+func _close() -> void:
+	set_process_input(false)
+	var layer := get_parent()
+	if layer is CanvasLayer:
+		layer.queue_free()
+	else:
+		queue_free()
+
+
+func _new_folder() -> void:
+	_new_box.visible = true
+	var le: LineEdit = _new_box.get_node("NewName")
+	le.text = "New Folder"
+	le.grab_focus()
+	le.select_all()
+
+
+func _make_folder() -> void:
+	var le: LineEdit = _new_box.get_node("NewName")
+	var n := le.text.strip_edges()
+	if n == "" or n.contains("/"):
+		_say("Give the folder a name.", true)
+		return
+	var full := dir.path_join(n)
+	if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(full):
+		_say("%s is there already." % n, true)
+		return
+	var err := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(full)
+	if err != OK:
+		_say("Couldn't make %s (%s)." % [n, error_string(err)], true)
+		return
+	_new_box.visible = false
+	_go(full)
+
+
+func _say(t: String, bad := false) -> void:
+	if _status == null:
+		return
+	_status.text = t
+	_status.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.35) if bad or t.contains("overwrites") else UI.TEXT_DIM)
hunks.title: FileBrowser

+## The model's own file saved over (the editor's Save) since the game imported it: read as glTF at run time
+## till it's imported again - a save shows at once. (An exported game: never - its files can't change.)
+static func stale(model_path: String) -> bool:
+	if not model_path.get_extension().to_lower() in ["glb", "gltf"] or not FileAccess.file_exists(model_path + ".import"):
+		return false
+	var cf := ConfigFile.new()
+	if cf.load(model_path + ".import") != OK:
+		return false
+	var imp := str(cf.get_value("remap", "path", ""))
+	if imp == "":
+		return false
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(imp):
+		return true
+	return FileAccess.get_modified_time(model_path) > FileAccess.get_modified_time(imp) + 1

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,322 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Field-aligned quads for one face (scripts/editor/mesh/field_remesh.gd): watertight on the rim's samples,
+## nothing turned over, nearly all quads, a good topology score (scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd) - on a
+## dome, a flat six-sided face with a hole, a curved band (coarse, long thin triangles), a messy face (folds,
+## a flap) - and fast enough.
+
+const FR := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/field_remesh.gd")
+const TOPO := preload("res://tests/test_topology.gd")
+const TS := "res://scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd"
+
+
+## A face's rim loops (the triangles' way round), each resampled about L apart - its sharp corners (a turn over
+## `corner_deg`) and `keep` points kept as samples, the runs between them evenly divided. The longest loop
+## first.
+static func rim_loops(v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, tris: Array, L: float, keep := {}, corner_deg := 50.0) -> Array:
+	var dir := {}
+	for ti in tris:
+		for j in 3:
+			dir[Vector2i(t[int(ti) * 3 + j], t[int(ti) * 3 + (j + 1) % 3])] = true
+	var nxt := {}
+	for k: Vector2i in dir:
+		if not dir.has(Vector2i(k.y, k.x)):
+			nxt[k.x] = k.y
+	var out := []
+	var lens := []
+	while not nxt.is_empty():
+		var st: int = nxt.keys()[0]
+		var loop := [st]
+		var cur: int = nxt[st]
+		nxt.erase(st)
+		while cur != st and nxt.has(cur):
+			loop.append(cur)
+			var nx: int = nxt[cur]
+			nxt.erase(cur)
+			cur = nx
+		var n := loop.size()
+		var corner := []
+		for i in n:
+			var a := v[loop[(i - 1 + n) % n]]
+			var b := v[loop[i]]
+			var c := v[loop[(i + 1) % n]]
+			if keep.has(loop[i]) or (b - a).angle_to(c - b) > deg_to_rad(corner_deg):
+				corner.append(i)
+		var pts := PackedVector3Array()
+		var total := 0.0
+		for i in n:
+			total += v[loop[i]].distance_to(v[loop[(i + 1) % n]])
+		if corner.is_empty():
+			var m := maxi(4, roundi(total / L))
+			_resample(v, loop, 0, n, m, pts)
+		else:
+			for ci in corner.size():
+				var a: int = corner[ci]
+				var b: int = corner[(ci + 1) % corner.size()]
+				var span := (b - a + n) % n
+				if span == 0:
+					span = n
+				var ln := 0.0
+				for k in span:
+					ln += v[loop[(a + k) % n]].distance_to(v[loop[(a + k + 1) % n]])
+				_resample(v, loop, a, span, maxi(1, roundi(ln / L)), pts)
+		if pts.size() < 4:
+			# (a tiny loop: four samples round it at least)
+			pts = PackedVector3Array()
+			_resample(v, loop, 0, n, 4, pts)
+		out.append(pts)
+		lens.append(total)
+	# (the longest first)
+	var order := range(out.size())
+	order.sort_custom(func(x, y): return float(lens[x]) > float(lens[y]))
+	return order.map(func(i): return out[i])
+
+
+## The run of `span` sides from loop[a], cut into m pieces: its points from the start (not the end).
+static func _resample(v: PackedVector3Array, loop: Array, a: int, span: int, m: int, pts: PackedVector3Array) -> void:
+	var n := loop.size()
+	var cum := [0.0]
+	for k in span:
+		cum.append(float(cum[k]) + v[loop[(a + k) % n]].distance_to(v[loop[(a + k + 1) % n]]))
+	var total: float = cum[span]
+	var j := 0
+	for s in m:
+		var d := total * s / m
+		while j < span - 1 and float(cum[j + 1]) < d:
+			j += 1
+		var seg := float(cum[j + 1]) - float(cum[j])
+		var u := clampf((d - float(cum[j])) / seg, 0.0, 1.0) if seg > 0.0 else 0.0
+		pts.append(v[loop[(a + j) % n]].lerp(v[loop[(a + j + 1) % n]], u))
+
+
+## A fill as a mesh, its quads split along the diagonal that keeps both halves facing its way (as
+## edge_net._quads_out does), its rim samples the solid's edges (a closed chain a loop): {v, t, fv, chains}.
+static func as_mesh(res: Dictionary, loops: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var v := PackedVector3Array()
+	var starts := []
+	for l in loops:
+		starts.append(v.size())
+		v.append_array(l)
+	var ns := v.size()
+	v.append_array(res["pts"])
+	var ix := func(x: int) -> int:
+		return -1 - x if x < 0 else ns + x
+	var t := PackedInt32Array()
+	for f in res["faces"]:
+		var c: Array = (f as Array).map(func(x): return ix.call(int(x)))
+		if c.size() == 3:
+			t.append_array(PackedInt32Array(c))
+			continue
+		var a: int = c[0]
+		var b: int = c[1]
+		var cc: int = c[2]
+		var d: int = c[3]
+		var qn := (v[cc] - v[a]).cross(v[d] - v[b])
+		var f1 := func(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> float:
+			return (v[y] - v[x]).cross(v[z] - v[x]).dot(qn)
+		var ac_ok: bool = f1.call(a, b, cc) > 0.0 and f1.call(a, cc, d) > 0.0
+		var bd_ok: bool = f1.call(a, b, d) > 0.0 and f1.call(b, cc, d) > 0.0
+		var use_ac := v[a].distance_squared_to(v[cc]) >= v[b].distance_squared_to(v[d])
+		if use_ac and not ac_ok and bd_ok:
+			use_ac = false
+		elif not use_ac and not bd_ok and ac_ok:
+			use_ac = true
+		if use_ac:
+			t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, b, cc, a, cc, d]))
+		else:
+			t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, b, d, b, cc, d]))
+	var fv := []
+	var chains := []
+	for li in loops.size():
+		var n: int = (loops[li] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+		chains.append({"id": li, "closed": true})
+		for k in n:
+			fv.append([int(starts[li]) + k, li, float(k) / n])
+	return {"v": v, "t": t, "fv": fv, "chains": chains}
+
+
+## The face's own triangles as a mesh, its rim loops the edges: {v, t, fv, chains}.
+static func face_mesh(v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, tris: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var loc := {}
+	var lv := PackedVector3Array()
+	var lt := PackedInt32Array()
+	for ti in tris:
+		for j in 3:
+			var x := t[int(ti) * 3 + j]
+			if not loc.has(x):
+				loc[x] = lv.size()
+				lv.append(v[x])
+			lt.append(loc[x])
+	var dir := {}
+	for i in range(0, lt.size(), 3):
+		for j in 3:
+			dir[Vector2i(lt[i + j], lt[i + (j + 1) % 3])] = true
+	var nxt := {}
+	for k: Vector2i in dir:
+		if not dir.has(Vector2i(k.y, k.x)):
+			nxt[k.x] = k.y
+	var fv := []
+	var chains := []
+	while not nxt.is_empty():
+		var st: int = nxt.keys()[0]
+		var loop := [st]
+		var cur: int = nxt[st]
+		nxt.erase(st)
+		while cur != st and nxt.has(cur):
+			loop.append(cur)
+			var nx: int = nxt[cur]
+			nxt.erase(cur)
+			cur = nx
+		var ci := chains.size()
+		chains.append({"id": ci, "closed": true})
+		for k in loop.size():
+			fv.append([loop[k], ci, float(k) / loop.size()])
+	return {"v": lv, "t": lt, "fv": fv, "chains": chains}
+
+
+## Fills a face and measures it: {res, why, ms, bad (validate's answer), score (topo_score's dict), quads, tris}.
+static func run(v: PackedVector3Array, t: PackedInt32Array, tris: Array, L: float, loops := []) -> Dictionary:
+	if loops.is_empty():
+		loops = rim_loops(v, t, tris, L)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var res: Dictionary = FR.fill_face(v, t, tris, loops, L)
+	var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+	var out := {"res": res, "why": FR.why, "ms": ms, "stats": FR.stats.duplicate(), "loops": loops}
+	if res.is_empty():
+		out["bad"] = "nothing (%s)" % FR.why
+		return out
+	out["bad"] = FR.validate(v, t, tris, loops, res)
+	var q := 0
+	for f in res["faces"]:
+		if (f as Array).size() == 4:
+			q += 1
+	out["quads"] = q
+	out["tris"] = (res["faces"] as Array).size() - q
+	var mm := as_mesh(res, loops)
+	out["score"] = load(TS).score(mm["v"], mm["t"], mm["fv"], mm["chains"])
+	return out
+
+
+static func summary(r: Dictionary) -> String:
+	if not r.has("score"):
+		return "failed: %s" % str(r.get("bad", ""))
+	var s: Dictionary = r["score"]
+	return "score %.1f, quads %d, tris %d, quad_ratio %.3f, poles %d/%d, slivers %d, angle_dev %.1f, area_cv %.2f, %.0f ms" % [s["score"], r["quads"], r["tris"], s["quad_ratio"], s["poles"], s["interior"], s["slivers"], s["angle_dev"], s["area_cv"], r["ms"]]
+
+
+## A flat six-sided face (radius 1) with a round hole (radius 0.35, off centre), in rows of triangles from
+## the hole out to the rim.
+static func hex_with_hole(segs := 48, rows := 12) -> Dictionary:
+	var v := PackedVector3Array()
+	var c0 := Vector3(0.12, 0, -0.05)
+	for r in rows + 1:
+		var f := float(r) / rows
+		for k in segs:
+			var a := TAU * k / segs
+			var inner := c0 + Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * 0.35
+			# (the hexagon's rim along the same ray from the centre)
+			var sec := fposmod(a, TAU / 6.0) - TAU / 12.0
+			var rr := cos(TAU / 12.0) / cos(sec)
+			var outer := Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)) * rr
+			v.append(inner.lerp(outer, f))
+	var t := PackedInt32Array()
+	for r in rows:
+		for k in segs:
+			var k1 := (k + 1) % segs
+			var a := r * segs + k
+			var b := r * segs + k1
+			var cc := (r + 1) * segs + k
+			var d := (r + 1) * segs + k1
+			t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, cc, b, b, cc, d]))
+	return {"v": v, "t": t}
+
+
+static func all_tris(t: PackedInt32Array) -> Array:
+	return range(t.size() / 3)
+
+
+func _report(name: String, r: Dictionary) -> void:
+	print("  field_remesh %s: %s" % [name, summary(r)])
+
+
+func _check_fill(name: String, r: Dictionary, min_score: float) -> void:
+	_report(name, r)
+	check(r["bad"] == "", "%s: watertight, nothing turned over (%s)" % [name, r["bad"]])
+	if not r.has("score"):
+		return
+	var s: Dictionary = r["score"]
+	check(float(s["quad_ratio"]) >= 0.9, "%s: quads at least 9 in 10 (%.3f)" % [name, s["quad_ratio"]])
+	check(int(s["nonmanifold"]) == 0, "%s: manifold" % name)
+	check(int(s["misoriented"]) == 0, "%s: wound one way" % name)
+	check(float(s["score"]) >= min_score, "%s: score %.1f at least %.0f" % [name, s["score"], min_score])
+
+
+func test_dome() -> void:
+	var m := TOPO.dome(32, 10)
+	_check_fill("dome", run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.12), 80.0)
+
+
+func test_hexagon_with_a_hole() -> void:
+	var m := hex_with_hole()
+	_check_fill("hexagon with a hole", run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.1), 72.0)
+
+
+func test_curved_band() -> void:
+	# (a coarse U-section ring: long thin triangles across its width, two rims)
+	var m := TOPO.u_band(24)
+	_check_fill("curved band", run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.06), 78.0)
+
+
+func test_messy_face() -> void:
+	# (a dome whose inner points are shaken till triangles fold over, with a flap - one triangle there twice,
+	# both ways round - as a converted mesh can have: still filled, watertight, mostly quads)
+	var m := TOPO.dome(32, 10)
+	var v: PackedVector3Array = m["v"]
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = 7
+	for i in range(1, 1 + 8 * 32):
+		v[i] += Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1, 1), rng.randf_range(-0.3, 0.3), rng.randf_range(-1, 1)) * 0.06
+	var t: PackedInt32Array = m["t"]
+	t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([t[30], t[31], t[32], t[30], t[32], t[31]]))
+	var r := run(v, t, all_tris(t), 0.12, rim_loops(v, m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.12))
+	_report("messy face", r)
+	check(r["bad"] == "", "watertight, nothing turned over (%s)" % r["bad"])
+	if r.has("score"):
+		check(float(r["score"]["quad_ratio"]) >= 0.85, "mostly quads (%.3f)" % r["score"]["quad_ratio"])
+
+
+func test_rim_given_the_other_way_round() -> void:
+	var m := TOPO.dome(32, 10)
+	var loops := rim_loops(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.12)
+	var back := PackedVector3Array(loops[0])
+	back.reverse()
+	var r := run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.12, [back])
+	_report("rim reversed", r)
+	check(r["bad"] == "", "watertight, nothing turned over (%s)" % r["bad"])
+
+
+func test_rim_samples_kept_exactly() -> void:
+	var m := TOPO.dome(32, 10)
+	var r := run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.12)
+	check(r["bad"] == "", "filled (%s)" % r["bad"])
+	if r["res"].is_empty():
+		return
+	# (each rim sample a corner of some face, and no new point on the rim's line)
+	var loops: Array = r["loops"]
+	var rim: PackedVector3Array = loops[0]
+	var pts: PackedVector3Array = r["res"]["pts"]
+	var near := 0
+	for p in pts:
+		if absf(p.y) < 1e-4:
+			near += 1
+	check_eq(near, 0, "no inner point on the rim")
+	check(rim.size() > 0, "the rim sampled")
+
+
+func test_speed_on_a_4000_triangle_face() -> void:
+	var m := TOPO.dome(64, 32)
+	var nt: int = m["t"].size() / 3
+	check(nt >= 4000, "a big face (%d triangles)" % nt)
+	var r := run(m["v"], m["t"], all_tris(m["t"]), 0.1)
+	_report("4000 triangles", r)
+	check(r["bad"] == "", "filled (%s)" % r["bad"])
+	check(float(r["ms"]) < 5000.0, "under 5 s (%.0f ms; %s)" % [r["ms"], str(r["stats"])])

+extends TestCase
+## The topology scorer (scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd): a regular grid of quads scores near 100, the same
+## grid with its triangles flipped and its points jittered clearly lower, a fan of triangles low.
+
+const TS := "res://scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd"
+
+
+## A flat n x n grid of quads (each two triangles split along a diagonal), its rim four edges of the solid.
+## [v, t, fv, chains]
+func _grid(n: int) -> Array:
+	var v := PackedVector3Array()
+	for z in n + 1:
+		for x in n + 1:
+			v.append(Vector3(x, 0, z) * 0.1)
+	var t := PackedInt32Array()
+	for z in n:
+		for x in n:
+			var a := z * (n + 1) + x
+			var b := a + 1
+			var c := a + n + 1
+			var d := c + 1
+			t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, c, d, a, d, b]))
+	var fv := []
+	for i in n + 1:
+		var p := float(i) / n
+		fv.append([i, 0, p])                           # (z = 0)
+		fv.append([n * (n + 1) + i, 1, p])             # (z = n)
+		fv.append([i * (n + 1), 2, p])                 # (x = 0)
+		fv.append([i * (n + 1) + n, 3, p])             # (x = n)
+	var chains := [{"id": 1, "closed": false}, {"id": 2, "closed": false}, {"id": 3, "closed": false}, {"id": 4, "closed": false}]
+	return [v, t, fv, chains]
+
+
+## Flips `count` random inner sides (where the two triangles still face up after) and moves the inner points
+## up to `jit` of a cell's width.
+func _spoil(g: Array, count: int, jit: float, seed_n: int) -> Array:
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = seed_n
+	var v: PackedVector3Array = (g[0] as PackedVector3Array).duplicate()
+	var t: PackedInt32Array = (g[1] as PackedInt32Array).duplicate()
+	var on := {}
+	for e in g[2]:
+		on[int(e[0])] = true
+	for i in v.size():
+		if not on.has(i):
+			v[i] += Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1, 1), 0, rng.randf_range(-1, 1)) * jit * 0.1
+	var nt := t.size() / 3
+	var flips := 0
+	for attempt in count * 20:
+		if flips >= count:
+			break
+		var i := rng.randi_range(0, nt - 1)
+		var j := rng.randi_range(0, 2)
+		var a := t[i * 3 + j]
+		var b := t[i * 3 + (j + 1) % 3]
+		var c := t[i * 3 + (j + 2) % 3]
+		for o in nt:
+			if o == i:
+				continue
+			for k in 3:
+				if t[o * 3 + k] == b and t[o * 3 + (k + 1) % 3] == a:
+					var d := t[o * 3 + (k + 2) % 3]
+					# (a b c + b a d -> c a d + d b c)
+					var n1 := (v[a] - v[c]).cross(v[d] - v[c])
+					var n2 := (v[b] - v[d]).cross(v[c] - v[d])
+					var up := (v[b] - v[a]).cross(v[c] - v[a])
+					if n1.dot(up) > 0 and n2.dot(up) > 0:
+						t[i * 3] = c
+						t[i * 3 + 1] = a
+						t[i * 3 + 2] = d
+						t[o * 3] = d
+						t[o * 3 + 1] = b
+						t[o * 3 + 2] = c
+						flips += 1
+	return [v, t, g[2], g[3]]
+
+
+func test_perfect_grid_near_100() -> void:
+	var S: GDScript = load(TS)
+	var g := _grid(10)
+	var r: Dictionary = S.score(g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3])
+	check_eq(r["quads"], 100, "100 quads")
+	check(is_equal_approx(r["quad_ratio"], 1.0), "all quads (%s)" % r["quad_ratio"])
+	check_eq(r["poles"], 0, "no poles")
+	check_eq(r["interior"], 81, "81 inner points")
+	check(r["angle_dev"] < 0.01 and r["slivers"] == 0, "square corners, no slivers")
+	check_eq(r["shade_bad"], 0, "flat: no creases")
+	check_eq(r["open_sides"], 40, "the rim open")
+	check_eq(r["nonmanifold"], 0, "manifold")
+	check(r["score"] > 99.0, "scores near 100 (%.1f)" % r["score"])
+
+
+func test_spoiled_grid_lower() -> void:
+	var S: GDScript = load(TS)
+	var g := _grid(10)
+	var best: float = S.score(g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3])["score"]
+	var bad := _spoil(g, 40, 0.35, 7)
+	var r: Dictionary = S.score(bad[0], bad[1], bad[2], bad[3])
+	check(r["quad_ratio"] < 0.9, "flips leave triangles (%.2f)" % r["quad_ratio"])
+	check(r["poles"] > 0, "and poles (%d)" % r["poles"])
+	check(r["score"] < best - 15.0, "scores clearly lower: %.1f vs %.1f" % [r["score"], best])
+	var jit := _spoil(g, 0, 0.35, 3)
+	var rj: Dictionary = S.score(jit[0], jit[1], jit[2], jit[3])
+	check(rj["angle_dev"] > 5.0 and rj["area_cv"] > 0.1, "jitter alone: crooked, uneven quads (%.1f deg, cv %.2f)" % [rj["angle_dev"], rj["area_cv"]])
+	check(rj["score"] < best - 5.0, "jitter alone scores lower: %.1f" % rj["score"])
+
+
+func test_fan_low() -> void:
+	var S: GDScript = load(TS)
+	var v := PackedVector3Array([Vector3.ZERO])
+	var t := PackedInt32Array()
+	var fv := []
+	var n := 24
+	for i in n:
+		var a := TAU * i / n
+		v.append(Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)))
+		fv.append([i + 1, 0, float(i) / n])
+	for i in n:
+		t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([0, 1 + (i + 1) % n, 1 + i]))
+	var r: Dictionary = S.score(v, t, fv, [{"id": 1, "closed": true}])
+	check_eq(r["poles"], 1, "the hub a pole")
+	check(r["score"] < 40.0, "a fan scores low (%.1f)" % r["score"])
+
+
+func test_fast() -> void:
+	var S: GDScript = load(TS)
+	var g := _grid(70)   # (9800 triangles)
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	var r: Dictionary = S.score(g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3])
+	var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+	check_eq(r["triangles"], 9800, "9800 triangles")
+	check_lt(ms, 1000.0, "scored in under a second (ms)")

+extends TestCase
+## The rules for any mesh ECurves lays out (data/docs/editor.md, "mesh-curves-topology"): checked on flat
+## patches whose answer is known - a face with n corners is n grids round one pole (none for four).
+
+const EN := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/edge_net.gd")
+
+
+## A flat n-gon (corners on a circle of radius 1) finely cut into triangles (a fan of strips), its n sides
+## each an edge: {v, t, fv, chains}.
+static func ngon(n: int, rings := 14) -> Dictionary:
+	var v := PackedVector3Array([Vector3.ZERO])
+	var t := PackedInt32Array()
+	var C := []
+	for i in n:
+		var a := TAU * i / n
+		C.append(Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)))
+	# (rings of points: ring r has n*r points, along the n-gon's sides scaled by r/rings)
+	var ring_start := [0]
+	for r in range(1, rings + 1):
+		ring_start.append(v.size())
+		for i in n:
+			for k in r:
+				v.append(((C[i] as Vector3).lerp(C[(i + 1) % n], float(k) / r)) * float(r) / rings)
+	for r in range(1, rings + 1):
+		var cur: int = ring_start[r]
+		var cn := n * r
+		if r == 1:
+			for k in cn:
+				t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([0, cur + (k + 1) % cn, cur + k]))
+			continue
+		var prv: int = ring_start[r - 1]
+		var pn := n * (r - 1)
+		for i in n:
+			for k in r:
+				var a := cur + i * r + k
+				var b := cur + (i * r + k + 1) % cn
+				var pk := i * (r - 1) + mini(k, r - 1)
+				var p := prv + pk % pn
+				t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, p, b]))
+				if k < r - 1:
+					var p2 := prv + (pk + 1) % pn
+					t.append_array(PackedInt32Array([b, p, p2]))
+	var fv := []
+	var chains := []
+	var outer: int = ring_start[rings]
+	for i in n:
+		chains.append({"id": i, "closed": false})
+		for k in rings + 1:
+			var vi := outer + (i * rings + k) % (n * rings)
+			fv.append([vi, i, float(k) / rings])
+	return {"v": v, "t": t, "fv": fv, "chains": chains}
+
+
+## Its layout's quads, and its inner points' valences (how many quads meet there): {quads, faces, poles}.
+static func layout(m: Dictionary, L: float) -> Dictionary:
+	EN.pair_why = {}
+	var g: Dictionary = EN.grid_faces(m["v"], m["t"], m["fv"], m["chains"], L)
+	if g.is_empty():
+		return {"why": EN.grid_why}
+	var fs: Array = EN._pair_faces(g["v"], g["t"], g["fv"])
+	var val := {}
+	for f in fs:
+		for x in f:
+			val[x] = int(val.get(x, 0)) + 1
+	var on := {}
+	for e in g["fv"]:
+		on[int(e[0])] = true
+	var poles := []
+	for x in val:
+		if not on.has(x) and int(val[x]) != 4:
+			poles.append(val[x])
+	return {"quads": fs.filter(func(f): return (f as Array).size() == 4).size(), "faces": fs.size(), "poles": poles, "log": EN.grid_log}
+
+
+func test_closed_form_spokes() -> void:
+	check_eq(EN.cc_spokes([4, 4, 4]), [2, 2, 2], "a triangle 4/4/4: spokes of 2")
+	check_eq(EN.cc_spokes([6, 4, 3, 5, 4]), EN.cc_spokes([6, 4, 3, 5, 4]), "the paper's pentagon solves")
+	check(not EN.cc_spokes([6, 4, 3, 5, 4]).is_empty(), "(6, 4, 3, 5, 4) can be laid out (the paper's example)")
+	check(EN.cc_spokes([8, 2, 2]).is_empty(), "a side as long as the other two: no layout")
+
+
+func test_triangle_is_three_grids_round_one_pole() -> void:
+	var r := layout(ngon(3), 0.15)
+	check(r.has("quads"), "laid out (%s)" % str(r.get("why", "")))
+	if r.has("quads"):
+		check_eq(r["quads"], r["faces"], "all quads")
+		check_eq(r["poles"], [3], "one pole, three quads meeting (%s)" % str(r["log"]))
+
+
+func test_pentagon_and_hexagon_one_pole_each() -> void:
+	for n in [5, 6]:
+		var r := layout(ngon(n), 0.15)
+		check(r.has("quads"), "%d sides: laid out (%s)" % [n, str(r.get("why", ""))])
+		if r.has("quads"):
+			check_eq(r["quads"], r["faces"], "%d sides: all quads" % n)
+			# (one pole of n - or, better still, none: a grid with two corners left on its sides, as a six-sided

+			var p: Array = r["poles"]
+			check(p.is_empty() or p == [n], "%d sides: one pole of %d or none (%s; %s)" % [n, n, str(p), str(r["log"])])

+## A hemisphere (latitude rings of triangles), its rim one closed edge.
+static func dome(segs := 32, rows := 10) -> Dictionary:

+			var b := t[ti * 3 + (j + 1) % 3]
+			var k := Vector2i(mini(a, b), maxi(a, b))
+			cnt[k] = int(cnt.get(k, 0)) + 1
+	var nxt := {}
+	for ti in t.size() / 3:
+		for j in 3:
+			var a := t[ti * 3 + j]
+			var b := t[ti * 3 + (j + 1) % 3]
+			if int(cnt[Vector2i(mini(a, b), maxi(a, b))]) == 1:
+				nxt[a] = b
+	var st: int = nxt.keys()[0]
+	var loop := [st]
+	var cur: int = nxt[st]
+	while cur != st:
+		loop.append(cur)
+		cur = nxt[cur]
+	var fv := []
+	for k in loop.size():
+		fv.append([loop[k], 0, float(k) / loop.size()])
+	return {"v": v, "t": t, "fv": fv, "chains": [{"id": 0, "closed": true}]}
+
+
+## A face the grids fit badly (a cross: twelve corners) is laid out by the field-aligned fill - all quads,
+## a closed surface (its rim the edge's samples, every inner side shared by two triangles).
+func test_cross_laid_out_by_its_flow() -> void:
+	var m := cross()
+	var g: Dictionary = EN.grid_any(m["v"], m["t"], m["fv"], m["chains"], 0.125)
+	check(not g.is_empty(), "laid out (%s)" % EN.grid_why)
+	if g.is_empty():
+		return
+	var ts: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd")
+	var sc: Dictionary = ts.score(g["v"], g["t"], g["fv"], m["chains"])
+	check(sc["quad_ratio"] > 0.95, "quads (%.0f%%)" % (sc["quad_ratio"] * 100.0))
+	check(sc["score"] > 85.0, "clean (score %.1f, poles %d, slivers %d)" % [sc["score"], sc["poles"], sc["slivers"]])
+	check_eq(sc["nonmanifold"], 0, "no side on three triangles")
+	# (its open sides: exactly its rim - as many as the edge's samples)
+	var rim := 0
+	for e in g["fv"]:
+		rim += 1 if int(e[1]) == 0 else 0
+	check_eq(sc["open_sides"], rim, "open only round its rim")
+
+
+## Laying out only some faces again (a knife's, an edit's) keeps the others as they were: a kept face never
+## takes points left over from an earlier layout (a stale fill once crashed the editor), and every point an
+## edge names is in the result.
+func test_part_laid_out_again_keeps_the_rest() -> void:
+	var m := cross()
+	var t: PackedInt32Array = m["t"]
+	var only := {}
+	for i in range(0, t.size() / 3, 2):
+		only[i] = true   # (every other triangle: some faces laid out again, the rest kept)
+	EN.fill_out_v = PackedVector3Array([Vector3.ZERO])   # (an earlier layout's leftovers, shorter than this one)
+	var g: Dictionary = EN.grid_any(m["v"], m["t"], m["fv"], m["chains"], 0.125, true, only)
+	check(not g.is_empty(), "laid out (%s)" % EN.grid_why)
+	if g.is_empty():
+		return
+	var n: int = (g["v"] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+	var bad := 0
+	for i in (g["t"] as PackedInt32Array):
+		bad += 1 if i < 0 or i >= n else 0
+	check_eq(bad, 0, "every triangle's corners among its points")
+	var bad_fv := 0
+	for e in g["fv"]:
+		bad_fv += 1 if int(e[0]) < 0 or int(e[0]) >= n else 0
+	check_eq(bad_fv, 0, "every edge's point among its points")

files.explanation: New tool: scores every solid of a model as it is and laid out again, timed - the baseline the work was measured on.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,190 @@ 
+extends SceneTree
+## The topology baseline: every ECurves solid of a model scored against the topology rules
+## (scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd) - its mesh as it is, and laid out again by edge_net.grid_any (timed).
+##   XDG_DATA_HOME=<scratch> godot --headless --path . -s tools/topo_bench.gd -- <model.glb> <out.json> [name filter]
+## Writes a JSON report (each solid + totals) and prints a table. Solids: the glb's nodes whose glTF extras
+## carry "atrapos_curves" (the solid's recipe) of kind "edges".
+
+const KEYS := ["quad_ratio", "pole_ratio", "angle_dev", "aspect", "sliver_ratio", "area_cv", "shade_ratio", "score"]
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	if OS.get_environment("FR_TRACE") != "":
+		(load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/field_remesh.gd") as GDScript).set("trace", true)
+	var args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
+	if args.size() < 2:
+		printerr("usage: -- <model.glb> <out.json> [name filter]")
+		quit(2)
+		return
+	var filt := args[2] if args.size() > 2 else ""
+	if filt == "-":
+		filt = ""
+	# (tuning: -- <glb> <json> <filter or -> name=value ... : edge_net's switches)
+	for a in args.slice(3):
+		var kv := (a as String).split("=")
+		if kv.size() == 2:
+			var nn: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/edge_net.gd")
+			if kv[0].begins_with("FR."):   # (field_remesh's tuning)
+				nn = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/field_remesh.gd")
+				kv[0] = kv[0].substr(3)
+			nn.set(kv[0], str_to_var(kv[1]))
+	var io: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd")
+	var net: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/edge_net.gd")
+	var ts: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/topo_score.gd")
+	var root: Node3D = io.read(args[0])
+	if root == null:
+		printerr("can't read ", args[0])
+		quit(2)
+		return
+	var solids := []
+	_find(root, solids)
+	var rows := []
+	var tot := {"cur": _zero(), "grid": _zero()}
+	var fails := 0
+	var grid_ms := 0.0
+	var methods := {}
+	var qual := {}   # (each layout: [quads, slivers] over the model)
+	var ring_bad := []   # (rings with slivers: [slivers, quads, solid, the face, why another way failed])   # (how the faces were laid out: "cc 3", "grid 4", "rings 0", ... - counts)
+	var whys := {}
+	var n := 0
+	for s: Array in solids:
+		var name: String = s[0]
+		var rec: Dictionary = s[1]
+		if str(rec.get("kind", "")) != "edges" or not rec.has("mesh"):
+			continue
+		if filt != "" and not name.contains(filt):
+			continue
+		var v := PackedVector3Array()
+		var fl: Array = rec["mesh"]["v"]
+		for i in range(0, fl.size() - 2, 3):
+			v.append(Vector3(float(fl[i]), float(fl[i + 1]), float(fl[i + 2])))
+		var t := PackedInt32Array()
+		for x in rec["mesh"]["t"]:
+			t.append(int(x))
+		var fv := []
+		for e in rec.get("fv", []):
+			fv.append([int(e[0]), int(e[1]), float(e[2])])
+		var chains := []
+		for c in rec.get("chains", []):
+			chains.append({"id": int(c.get("id", -1)), "closed": bool(c.get("closed", false))})
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		var cur: Dictionary = ts.score(v, t, fv, chains)
+		var score_ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+		var area := 0.0
+		for i in range(0, t.size(), 3):
+			area += 0.5 * (v[t[i + 1]] - v[t[i]]).cross(v[t[i + 2]] - v[t[i]]).length()
+		var L := clampf(sqrt(area / 380.0), 0.003, 1.0) * 0.55
+		t0 = Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		printerr("  laying out ", name, " (", t.size() / 3, " triangles)")
+		var g: Dictionary = net.grid_any(v, t, fv, chains, L)
+		var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+		grid_ms += ms
+		var gl: Array = net.get("grid_log")
+		for i in gl.size():
+			var e: Array = gl[i]
+			# (a rings fallback's quads: measured after it - the next face's note is its own)
+			if str(e[1]) == "rings":
+				pass
+			if e.size() > 6 and not str(e[1]).ends_with("failed"):
+				var mk := str(e[1]) + " " + str(e[2])
+				if not qual.has(mk):
+					qual[mk] = [0, 0, 0]
+				qual[mk][0] += int(e[6][0])
+				qual[mk][1] += int(e[6][1])
+				qual[mk][2] += int(e[6][2]) if (e[6] as Array).size() > 2 else 0
+		for i in gl.size():
+			if str(gl[i][1]) == "rings made" and i > 0 and int(gl[i][6][1]) > 0:
+				ring_bad.append([int(gl[i][6][1]), int(gl[i][6][0]), name, str(gl[i - 1][2]), str(gl[i - 1][3]).left(60)])
+		for e in net.get("grid_log"):
+			var key := "%s %s" % [str(e[1]), str(e[2])]
+			methods[key] = int(methods.get(key, 0)) + 1
+			if str(e[1]).ends_with("failed"):
+				var why := str(e[3]).get_slice(":", 0) + ":" + str(e[3]).get_slice(":", 1).left(24)
+				whys[why] = int(whys.get(why, 0)) + 1
+		n += 1
+		var row := {"name": name, "triangles": t.size() / 3, "chains": chains.size(), "area": area, "L": L,
+			"score_ms": score_ms, "grid_ms": ms, "current": cur}
+		_add(tot["cur"], cur)
+		if g.is_empty():
+			fails += 1
+			row["grid"] = null
+			row["grid_why"] = str(net.get("grid_why"))
+		else:
+			var gv := PackedVector3Array(g["v"])
+			var gt := PackedInt32Array(g["t"])
+			var gs: Dictionary = ts.score(gv, gt, g["fv"], chains)
+			gs["kept"] = int(g.get("kept", 0))
+			gs["cuts"] = int(g.get("cuts", 0))
+			row["grid"] = gs
+			_add(tot["grid"], gs)
+		rows.append(row)
+		print("%-28s %6d tris  cur %5.1f  grid %s  %7.0f ms" % [name.left(28), t.size() / 3, cur["score"],
+			("%5.1f" % row["grid"]["score"]) if row["grid"] != null else "FAIL ", ms])
+	var report := {"model": args[0], "solids": rows.size(), "grid_failures": fails, "grid_ms_total": grid_ms,
+		"grid_ms_mean": grid_ms / maxf(1, n), "totals": {"current": _fin(tot["cur"]), "grid": _fin(tot["grid"])}, "rows": rows}
+	var f := FileAccess.open(args[1], FileAccess.WRITE)
+	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(report, "\t"))
+	f.close()
+	print("")
+	print("%-12s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %10s %8s" % ["", "solids", "quads%", "poles", "slivers", "shade!", "open", "nonmanif", "score"])
+	for k in ["current", "grid"]:
+		var a: Dictionary = report["totals"][k]
+		print("%-12s %8d %8.1f %8d %8d %8d %8d %10d %8.1f" % [k, a["n"], 100.0 * a["quad_ratio"], a["poles"], a["slivers"],
+			a["shade_bad"], a["open_sides"], a["nonmanifold"], a["score_mean"]])
+	print("grid_any: %d failed, %.0f ms total, %.0f ms a solid" % [fails, grid_ms, grid_ms / maxf(1, n)])
+	print("layouts: ", methods)
+	print("quality by layout [quads, slivers]: ", qual)
+	ring_bad.sort_custom(func(x, y): return int(x[0]) > int(y[0]))
+	for r in ring_bad.slice(0, 16):
+		print("  ring ", r)
+	print("why another way failed: ", whys)
+	print("pairs refused: ", net.get("pair_why"))
+	print("kept because: ", net.get("kept_why"))
+	print("fills: ", net.get("fill_log"))
+	print("prof: ", net.get("prof"))
+	if filt != "":
+		for e in net.get("grid_log"):
+			print("  ", e)
+	root.free()
+	quit(0)
+
+
+func _find(n: Node, out: Array) -> void:
+	var rec = null
+	if n.has_meta("curve_solid"):
+		rec = n.get_meta("curve_solid")
+	elif n.has_meta("extras"):
+		var ex = n.get_meta("extras")
+		if ex is Dictionary and ex.get("atrapos_curves") is Dictionary:
+			rec = ex["atrapos_curves"]
+	if rec is Dictionary:
+		out.append([str(n.name), rec])
+	for c in n.get_children():
+		_find(c, out)
+
+
+func _zero() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"n": 0, "faces": 0, "quads": 0, "tris": 0, "interior": 0, "poles": 0, "slivers": 0, "inner_sides": 0,
+		"shade_bad": 0, "open_sides": 0, "nonmanifold": 0, "misoriented": 0, "score_sum": 0.0, "angle_sum": 0.0, "cv_sum": 0.0}
+
+
+func _add(a: Dictionary, r: Dictionary) -> void:
+	a["n"] += 1
+	for k in ["faces", "quads", "tris", "interior", "poles", "slivers", "inner_sides", "shade_bad", "open_sides", "nonmanifold", "misoriented"]:
+		a[k] += int(r[k])
+	a["score_sum"] += float(r["score"])
+	a["angle_sum"] += float(r["angle_dev"])
+	a["cv_sum"] += float(r["area_cv"])
+
+
+func _fin(a: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var o := a.duplicate()
+	var n := maxf(1, a["n"])
+	o["quad_ratio"] = float(a["quads"]) / maxf(1, a["faces"])
+	o["pole_ratio"] = float(a["poles"]) / maxf(1, a["interior"])
+	o["sliver_ratio"] = float(a["slivers"]) / maxf(1, a["quads"])
+	o["shade_ratio"] = float(a["shade_bad"]) / maxf(1, a["inner_sides"])
+	o["score_mean"] = a["score_sum"] / n
+	o["angle_dev_mean"] = a["angle_sum"] / n
+	o["area_cv_mean"] = a["cv_sum"] / n
+	return o
